business_summary: Yantai China Pet Foods Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells pet food products in China and internationally. The company offers pet snacks, staple food, and supplies, as well as dry and wet food, freeze-dried food, biscuits, and chew toys under the Wanpy, Toptrees, and Zeal brand names. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
